scientific_integrity: The polygon/ellipse classification is credited to earlier authors. Novelty is assessed from inspected evidence only; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Strictly the center parameter, uniform initial conditions on the two-step neutral-strip intersection; first departure from neutral branch, not global escape. No exact asymptotic coefficient is asserted for bounded-type rotations.
title: Exact neutral-branch survival and a Diophantine tail dichotomy in a planar discontinuous map
